wholePhysicalScope: Exact 2021 and 2022 Qualla originals, named 131-point survey outline, and the architectural sequence recorded in the Virginia Historic Landmark designation.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the connected hotel wings, columned main entrance and tiered clock tower. Near levels retain window frames, paired veranda columns, and the clock face.
limitations: Exterior of the connected hotel in 2021–2022, including its 1902 entrance block and 1929 tower. Detached resort facilities, vegetation, snow and interiors are outside model scope.

The landmark designation and photos constrain the major sections, color and front architectural details. Rear openings, roof junctions, terrace levels, wing elevations and fine sculpture are approximate.
An unmodified elevation field establishes the valley grade. The exact building floor datum and historical grade are not surveyed.
